import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path('evaluation/scripts').resolve()))
from reference_frames import load_sensor_to_body,sensor_frame_poses
from run_official_kiss_matcher import sha,errors,expected_transform
from evaluate_external_kitti_odometry import load_reference_csv
r=Path('experiments/results/kiss_matcher_mcd_transfer')
p=json.loads((r/'protocol.json').read_text())
frame=json.loads((r/'calibrated_reference_protocol.json').read_text())
assert sha(r/'run/summary.json')==frame['uncalibrated_summary_sha256']
reference=Path('evaluation/fixtures/mcd_kth_smoke_gt.csv')
assert sha(reference)==frame['reference_csv_sha256']
calib=r/'hhs_ouster_sensor_to_body.json'
assert sha(calib)==frame['sensor_to_body_sha256']
poses=sensor_frame_poses(load_reference_csv(reference),load_sensor_to_body(calib))
original=json.loads((r/'run/summary.json').read_text())
rows=[]
for old in original['cases']:
 case=next(c for c in p['cases'] if c['id']==old['case'])
 estimate_path=r/'run'/(old['variant']+'__'+old['case']+'.estimate.json')
 assert sha(estimate_path)==old['estimate_sha256']
 estimate=json.loads(estimate_path.read_text())
 assert estimate['config']==next(v for v in p['variants'] if v['id']==old['variant'])['config']
 assert estimate['backend_files'] and old['exit_code']==0
 rotation,translation=errors(np.array(estimate['transform']),expected_transform(poses,case['source_frame'],case['target_frame'],case['source_yaw_deg']))
 rows.append({'variant':old['variant'],'case':old['case'],'uncalibrated_rotation_error_deg':old['rotation_error_deg'],'uncalibrated_translation_error_m':old['translation_error_m'],'rotation_error_deg':rotation,'translation_error_m':translation,'success':rotation<=frame['success_rotation_deg'] and translation<=frame['success_translation_m'],'native_estimate_sha256':sha(estimate_path)})
result={'kind':'Source-backed frame-corrected rescore of the same frozen estimates; no native rerun','frame_protocol_sha256':sha(r/'calibrated_reference_protocol.json'),'reference_sensor_to_body_sha256':sha(calib),'cases':rows,'scope':frame['scope'],'fixture_lineage_limitation':json.loads((r/'reference_sources.json').read_text())['fixture_limitation']}
(r/'calibrated_summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({v:{'successes':sum(x['success'] for x in rows if x['variant']==v),'max_rotation_error_deg':max(x['rotation_error_deg'] for x in rows if x['variant']==v),'max_translation_error_m':max(x['translation_error_m'] for x in rows if x['variant']==v)} for v in ['kiss_matcher','kiss_matcher_quatro']},indent=2))
